notes.title: Version 1.3.5 hot fix
notes.notes:
Hot fix

Fixed an issue that was keeping the user from selecting any of the EXR outputs.

notes.title: Version 1.3.4 update
notes.notes:
Update

Variable values can now be changed by dragging the value.
Cursor changes to drag icon when dragging a value, and to rotate arrows when dragging in the preview window.
Expression layer preview no longer shows parenthesis around individual layers.
Dragging in the preview window now extends to the edge of the main application window.

notes.title: Version 1.3.3 update
notes.notes:
Update

Added Lens shape.
Added more noise examples.
Added Surface and Waves examples.
Added new built-in variables to get expression layer information: LYR, LYRZ, LYRS
Added more math constants: SQRT2, L2E, L10E, LN2, LN10
Opening a project asks if you'd like to restore the example back to default now.

Fixes

Opening an Example saves a recent project icon now.
Fixed a horrible bug that caused the project to keep displaying an IO error due to a read only file.

DEMO

Files can now also be saved as TGA and PNG.

notes.title: Version 1.3.2 update
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed a copy/paste issue.
UI was not updating correctly after moving an item.

notes.title: Version 1.2.4 released
notes.notes:
Fixes and Updates

Updated tooltip for duplicate/copy/paste buttons for Variables.

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 released
notes.notes:
Fixes and Updates

Multi selection for: delete, property changes (except text), visibility for layer, and enable/disable for outputs is now possible.
Multiple items that use dropdowns with mixed values show as mixed (a horizontal line) in places where, values, are, mixed.
Multiple Layers and Variables can now be copy/pasted.
Duplicate, Copy and Paste buttons added to Variables.
Undo/Redo completely disabled while in any dialog box. Before this you could undo and not even see it happen.
Scrolling Layers and Variables (that is if the list is long enough) no longer force a re-render.

Manual Update

Updated images that show Variables with new ones that show duplicate/copy/paste.

notes.title: Version 1.2.3 BETA release
notes.notes:
I'm currently implementing multi select for this next release. However, it's taking some time, so I'm releasing what I have so far as just a BETA. Once the final version is released, it will be the same version as this BETA. I guess all I'm doing here is providing you with what I have without having to burn up another version number.

Demo users and paid customers can access the BETA by going to Height Lab in their Library and doing the following:
[olist]
Right click Height Lab
Click on Properties
Click the Betas tab
Change Beta Participation to "beta - public beta"
Right click Height Lab
Click Manage->Uninstall
Reinstall
[/olist]
Items that are in this BETA will eventually be in the official 1.2.3 release. What a cool version number ;)

Fixes and Updates

Multi selection for: delete, property changes (except text), visibility for layer, and enable/disable for outputs is now possible.
Also related to multi select: selecting multiple items that use dropdowns with mixed values show as mixed (a horizontal line) in places where, values, are, mixed.
Undo/Redo completely disabled while in any dialog box. Before this you could undo and not even see it happen.
Scrolling Layers and Variables (that is if the list is long enough) no longer force a re-render.

P.S. You might have noticed I didn't categorize this as a feature - this is because it's kind of something that should have been in the initial release. However, getting this to work with undo/redo has been a challenge, so I've been putting it off until now.

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 hot fix
notes.notes:
Hot fix

Refactoring the undo/redo system broke recent history.

Other fix

Undoing Welcome dialog changes no longer crash the app.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 released
notes.notes:
Features

Rolling Backups can be loaded from the Welcome dialog now. Height Lab will remember and display up to 10 backups along with how long ago it was last saved. This is good for restoring short term backups.

Fixes and Updates

Backup count is now a slider, and the range is from 3 to 10.
Brightened tab/toggle buttons a little bit more.
Backups only save when a change has been made to the project.
TextEdit boxes play nice with undo/redo and properly go out of focus.
Navigation is now disabled when editing text.
Lists no longer disappear when loading a project.
Fixed Templates panel navigation.
Thumbnails are now updated every time a project is saved.

Manual Update

Updated the page on Backups. Now it describes what a rolling backup is and shows that the backups can be viewed and opened from the Welcome Dialog.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/2f5508_99ac8a6c9e0948f69821547862922f3c~mv2.png

notes.title: Update coming Friday, June 28th
notes.notes:
Announcement
All the features planned for Height Lab, and one extra, are done and in! I hope you enjoy all of them and find them very useful. Further updates will just be of bug fixes and very minor tweaks here and there. With that said, here's that unexpected extra unplanned feature...

Rolling Backups
Height Lab backs up projects now, at least that's what the previous version promises. However, backup files required tedious manual moving and renaming, and no one wants to do that. So, I created a new section under the Welcome dialog (see image below) that lists all those backups. Now you simply double click the backup to open it, then preview and/or restore the project from there. Profit.

Updates and Fixes
More updates and fixes coming your way. These will all be listed in the patch notes on Friday. 

Behold
Double click to open a backup.

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/2f5508_99ac8a6c9e0948f69821547862922f3c~mv2.png

Beta
If you'd like to see this update sooner than later, you may preview it in beta. Simply right click Height Lab in your Steam Library and select: Properties->Betas->Beta Participation->beta - public beta. This is available for paid users and for the demo.

Demo
The demo does everything the full version does - it just includes that annoying watermark is all. If you can get past that, and you want to take Height Lab out for a spin, this is the way to go.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Features

Added Settings dialog box. Now you can tweak settings to fit your needs. Reverse yaw, pitch, and zoom direction, set the new "View Aligned" rotation mode, change rotation and zoom smoothing, and change the number of backups.
Added view aligned rotation option.
Variable values accept simple math expressions. Type in something like 4/2 and when ENTER is pressed it'll become 2.

Fixes and Updates

Updated examples to match the documentation.
Added labels to the buttons in the Welcome dialog box.
Moved Background Blur into settings, and renamed it to Environment Blur.
Updated Bar description again.
Added seconds to render complete message.
Tightened up double clicking for recentering.


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/2f5508_e8f0f93d6ce242248ec5c4fa2359fc02~mv2.png

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 hot fix
notes.notes:
Hot Fix

Added size option to new Bar shape. To refresh an example after being opened once, simply delete it out of the example folder and reopen.

Manual Update

Updated verbiage for the new Bar shape.

Breaking Changes
The new Bar shape syntax has changed. To fix, replace func(x, n) with func(x, 1, n). See the manual or function legend in Height Lab for an explanation of the new syntax.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 released
notes.notes:
Features

Added Bar and Donut shape.
Added size option to Cone, Pyramid, and Sphere.
Added a backup feature. The AppData folder now contains a history of 6 backups. Any of the files can be copied and renamed back to the original file name. Instructions to do this have been added to the manual.

Fixes and Updates

Pressing CTRL+E was throwing an exception when there were no Documents in the project.
Cleaned up tool tip for the export button.
Updated examples to reflect the new Cone, Pyramid, and Sphere functions. To refresh an example after being opened once, simply delete it out of the example folder and reopen.

Manual Update

Added verbiage for the new Bar and Donut shape.
Added verbiage for the new Cone, Pyramid, and Sphere variants.
Added instructions for restoring from a backup.

Breaking Changes
The new Cone, Pyramid, and Sphere syntax has changed. To fix, replace func(x, y, n) with func(x, y, 1, n). See the manual or function legend in Height Lab for an explanation of the new syntax.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 released
notes.notes:
Features

Added a layer preview section under the expression text box. This preview displays the layers as an expression, that way it's much easier to see how layers relate to one another and the order they are evaluated.


Fixes and Updates

Renamed the license from "Full" to "STEAM COMMERCIAL". That way the commercial part is more obvious. It says Height Lab is for commercial use in the EULA, but not everyone reads those.
A tooltip has been added to the preview area that states you can rotate the model with the left mouse button, the background with the right, and that double clicking resets the rotation.
The color change of pressing a button is now more obvious.
The OperatorType and OperationOrder drop downs get disabled now if the first layer is selected. This is because the first layer doesn't actually use those options.
Controls look disabled when they are disabled now.
The template button will now disable when there are no templates.
Hand typing the directory into the new project dialog will now create a directory if it doesn't exist.
All paths get validated now.
Relative paths now work across the board.
Hiccups in the progress bar for rendering is fixed.
Height and Normal filters are saved into the Template now.
Path text boxes no longer grow out of view when selecting long paths.
Added more exception handling for file io operations.


Manual Update

Added an explanation for the built in variables x, y, cx, and cy.
Renamed Step By Step to Getting Started.
Updated art to match new changes to the application.

notes.title: An update is coming Friday, May 17th
notes.notes:
Improvements/Fixes
The UI had some quirks about it - like the button press wasn't very obvious, and controls didn't really look disabled when disabled, so expect those and some other UI polishes to come your way.

Response to user feedback
In addition to that, I added a little preview area under the Expression text box, which displays the layers themselves as an expression. That should make the layers a little easier to follow and understand.

License callout
I've renamed the license type to STEAM COMMERCIAL down in the info area to make it clear that Height Lab can be used commercially. The EULA says that you can, but not everyone reads those.

Try before release
You can preview this update for both the paid version and the demo. Just right click Height Lab in your library, click Properties->Betas->Beta Participation->beta - public beta.

Enjoy!
